byteward.sentence: All 40 satellites have made contact with ground control, Orbelle said.
That brings the company's fleet to 412 satellites in orbit.
Orbelle plans to start selling internet service in mid-2027.

launch-desk.sentence: Orbelle put 40 more internet satellites into orbit overnight.
The company has raised $2.3 billion so far.
It needs 1,200 satellites in orbit by March 2030 to keep its spectrum license.

ohm-and-bit.sentence: Orbelle's latest launch carried 40 internet satellites.
They'll operate at an altitude of 590 km, low enough to keep the delay on a connection short.
Instead of bouncing every signal off the ground, the satellites pass data to each other by laser.
With this batch, Orbelle has 412 satellites in orbit.

bench-and-bill.sentence: The latest launch brings Orbelle to 412 satellites in orbit.
Under its Federal Spectrum Office license, the company must have 1,200 in orbit by March 2030.
If it falls short, the office can shrink the license to cover 600 satellites.
The license also requires Orbelle to move dead satellites out of orbit within five years.
